resource_load.note: Heavy write: user lookup + validation + paginated loops for unstar/unwatch/unassign/remove-collab/cancel-transfer in both directions + insert

performance_issues.description: Multiple paginated loops (unstarRepos, unwatchRepos, unassignIssues, removeCollaborations) each perform per-item operations inside loops
performance_issues.impact: For users with many shared resources, blocking could trigger hundreds of individual DB operations within a single transaction
performance_issues.code_snippet: for _, repo := range repos { repo_model.StarRepo(ctx, starrer, repo, false) }
performance_issues.recommendation: Use batch DELETE operations instead of per-item loops. Consider async processing for cleanup operations.

performance_issues.description: All cleanup operations (unstar, unwatch, unassign, remove collaborations, cancel transfers) run synchronously in a single transaction
performance_issues.impact: Long-running transaction holding locks on multiple tables; could timeout for users with extensive shared resources
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider splitting cleanup into async background job, only the blocking record insert needs to be synchronous

optimization_recommendations.description: Replace paginated per-item loops with batch DELETE statements
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce from O(n) queries to O(1) per cleanup type
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Use DELETE FROM star WHERE uid=? AND repo_id IN (SELECT id FROM repository WHERE owner_id=?) instead of per-repo StarRepo calls

optimization_recommendations.description: Move cleanup operations to background job
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce API response time from potentially seconds to milliseconds
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Insert blocking record synchronously, queue cleanup tasks for async processing

resource_load.note: 1 query for repos + 3 queries per repo (LoadUnits, IsCollaborator, LoadOwner)

performance_issues.description: GetIndividualUserRepoPermission is called per repo in a loop, each call triggers LoadUnits, IsCollaborator, and LoadOwner queries
performance_issues.impact: With default page size of 30, this generates ~90 additional queries per request
performance_issues.recommendation: Batch load repo units, collaborator status, and owners for all repos in the page at once

optimization_recommendations.description: Batch load permissions for all repos in the page
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce from 1+3N queries to ~4 queries total
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Pre-load repo units, collaborator status, and owners in batch before the loop
